title: fifty receipts, six buckets, three *picks*
dek: The live top-50 scan for the supplement-and-performance growth engagement: every row screened with a visible verdict, six topic buckets with named mechanisms, and a conversion column that decides in dollars - which bucket makes money, and how we know by batch three.
sources: competitive scan: 12 channels · 50 ranked videos · live web read aug 27

sections.heading: what the pool says
sections.body: Fifty ranked rows, twenty-five qualified for the avatar, twenty-five struck with reasons kept visible. Outlier means N-times that channel's own normal views-per-day, so a 2,800-view roundtable episode can outrank a 400K-view vlog. The pool's winners cluster broad (Rings 3-4: mechanism waves, platform shifts, founder stories); the in-lane supplement-operations bucket is the thinnest, two rows at 4x median. That thinness reads two ways and the artifact keeps both live: no incumbent has cracked the lane, and no demand proof exists. The trio protects the narrow picks against the pool's broad pull, and every bucket carries a working-equals threshold answerable in his own inbox by batch three.

rows.claim: A - Mechanism Waves: median 12.0x, rising (all rows Jul-Aug 2026). Mechanism: new-tool hope
rows.evidence: 'Claude Has Officially Changed Facebook Ads Forever' - 41K views, 21.8x, 2026-08-09. Feeds The Fix Aisle, reach-only, flagged honestly

rows.claim: B - Platform Shift: median 13.7x, ceiling 64.2x. Mechanism: chaos vigilance. Trap printed: a person winning, not a topic
rows.evidence: 'Amazon Just Lost Control Of Shopping!' - 1.4M views, 64.2x, 2026-04-28; two of three rows are the same channel

rows.claim: C - Founder Proof Stories: 7 rows, median 5.7x. Mechanism: possibility witness. The story SHAPE transfers; the exit-interview topic does not
rows.evidence: Quad Lock half-billion exit - 39K, 15.9x, 2026-07-30; five of seven rows are @foundr with celebrity guests

rows.claim: D - Operator Discipline: 7 rows, median 6.4x, rising (6 of 7 in Aug 2026). Mechanism: competence armor
rows.evidence: 'Do This to Scale Your CPG Brand' - 9.9K, 14.2x, 2026-08-13; Haus incrementality row proves ROAS distrust is already installed in the buyer's watering hole

rows.claim: E - In-Lane Supplement Ops: 2 rows, median 4.0x - the thinnest bucket IS the finding
rows.evidence: Gruns marketing-pod episode (6K, 4.1x, 2026-08-14) and Taste Salud build (12K, 3.9x, 2026-06-28) are the only in-lane rows in fifty; the money lane has no incumbent and no demand proof - both stated

rows.claim: F - Conversion Tactics: median 6.8x. Mechanism: fix-it-now utility
rows.evidence: Product-page blueprint - 12K, 19.9x, 2025-01-10; utility converts aspirants too, so reply-quality check before scaling

sections.heading: the live-market read
sections.tag: WHAT THE WIDER WEB SAYS · AUG 27

rows.claim: Amazon losing its grip on shopping — rising. The 'who controls product discovery' story keeps compounding
rows.evidence: Within 90 days: ChatGPT gained in-chat checkout through a major card issuer (Aug 17), Visa opened payments to AI shopping agents (June), and Amazon began licensing its own shopping assistant to other retailers (June)
rows.source_label: CNBC · Retail Dive · LA Times, Jun-Aug 2026

rows.claim: AI inside Meta ads — rising, and contested. Advertisers are actively arguing over how much creative to hand the machines
rows.evidence: Meta pushed AI deeper into ad creative all summer (its Muse Image generator, agency AI tools, a WPP integration) while Business Insider reported in July the push is causing chaos for brands
rows.source_label: Business Insider Jul 13 · Forbes Jul 8 · MediaPost Jun 23

rows.claim: The Etsy squeeze on print-on-demand — spiking right now
rows.evidence: Etsy's tightened Prohibited Items Policy took effect August 11, 2026, and the company cut 12% of staff the same week; seller-anxiety content asking whether Etsy is done with print-on-demand is fresh and multiplying

rows.claim: No-inventory supplement launching — flat, evergreen, and aimed at first-time starters rather than operating brands
rows.evidence: The 2026 guides to launching a supplement line with no inventory keep getting refreshed and the leading on-demand fulfillment platform anchors a whole comparison ecosystem, but no fresh news spike showed up — which confirms keeping this audience out of the working set
rows.source_label: Wonnda · On Demand Fulfillment · AutoDS, 2026 guides

rows.claim: Product-page fixes — steady demand with a fresh 2026 edge: the skeptical, label-reading buyer
rows.evidence: Supplement-specific conversion guides refreshed in mid-2026 treat ingredient transparency itself as the conversion lever, because this year's buyer reads labels, Googles ingredients, and cross-checks dosages against studies
rows.source_label: Absolute Web Jun 19 2026 · Forge Digital Marketing

sections.heading: the three picks, with the reasoning *shown*
sections.kicker: POSITIONING PICKS FROM THE POOL PERFORMANCE BUILT
sections.dek: Rank orders the pool; it does not dictate the pick.

items.action: The Defensible Claim (narrow, Ring 2) - a positioning bet with a written kill rule
items.why: Zero pool rows in the lane (the whitespace finding, not an endorsement); strongest offer linkage on the board; demand probe is batches 1-3 with the kill/keep already written

items.action: The Counter Files (narrow, Ring 2) - proof-story mechanism, receipted
items.why: Bucket C proves the mechanism at 5.7x median across 7 rows; his counter years are the uncopyable version; trap avoided: chasing foundr's topics without their guests chases a person-effect

items.action: The Fix Aisle (broad, Ring 4) - ride the pool's strongest current wave, install the belief
items.why: Buckets A+B are rising with a 64.2x skeleton ceiling; he can demo any mechanism honestly (90-agent system) before naming the decision it cannot make

items.action: Pass on the 64.2x Amazon topic; borrow its skeleton
items.why: The two-zone rule working as designed - Ring 5 and person-effect topics are craft sources, never topic sources

sections.heading: what the scan cannot *see*
sections.body: LinkedIn - where this business actually converts - is outside this scan. TikTok and Instagram: not measured. The scan sees views, never DMs: before crowning a conversion winner, confirm the replies come from operating founders, not aspirants. Momentum per bucket arrives with the next scan, spaced a day or more out. No verdict on any video at 24 hours; no bucket demotion before batches 2-3.
